description:
The Relaxed Body Recumbent E Trike is the latest in innovative electric tricycles from sixthreezero. Equipped with a rear mounted 750 watt motor this electric trike is not only powerful but safe and comfortable. The elongated, low center of gravity frame creates a exceptionally stable base that eliminates the fear of tipping, even on corners. The 3" wide tires grip the road securely adding to the unparalleled stability of this three wheel e bike. The recumbent style of the Relaxed Body means the pedals are position out in front of the riders body, creating a relaxed pedaling experience. The benefit is proper leg extension while being lower to the ground, and reduced pressure on the riders knees. With the forward pedaling design this recumbent e trike can be set low to the ground making mounting and dismounting safe and easy. The electric motor be utilized either when pedaling or by twisting the throttle. The five levels of pedal assist can easily glide riders up hills. Don't feel like pedaling up hill, twist the throttle and let the motor do all the work while you rest your legs. Use this the feature any time during your ride, a great way to rest your body and take in the environment. The large rear basket can fit all of your belongings, making the Relaxed Body a practical way to commute, run errands or just cruising around town.

750 Watt Rear Mount Motor That Powers Riders Up Hills & Top Speeds of 16mph

13" Step Over Height for Easy Mounting and Dismounting

Ergonomic, Upright Riding Position to Reduce Strain on Back, Hips, Shoulders, and Knees

3 Tektro Disc Brakes, 1 in front, 2 in Rear for "Stop on a Dime" Braking Power

Huge Rear Cargo Basket and Custom Basket Bags Options Available (Sold Separately)

Fits riders up to 350lbs and heights from 4'10" to 6'5"

Battery Compliant to the UL 2271 Standard as Tested by ACT Labs
